manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the handheld microphone from the table and pass it over.

Task description: Pick up the handheld microphone on the left side of the table, with a black microphone head and silver handle, and hand it from the left gripper to the right gripper.

Success criteria: Hold the microphone to the right of the robot centerline in the airborne handover region, more than twenty centimeters above the table or higher. The right gripper must be closed and physically touching it; the left must be open and released. Holding it with both grippers is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Consider having the left gripper grasp a straight section of the silver handle near, but not at, its tail end. Leave a straight section near the black microphone head for the right gripper to grasp.
- Place the pads on opposite sides of the handle, with an opening slightly wider than the selected rod section. Before closing, confirm the handle is actually between the fingers rather than only touching the rounded rod surface with the tips.
- Stagger the grippers along the microphone handle, preserving each pad's contact space. Release the left only after the right has a secure grasp to avoid gripper collisions or dropping the microphone.
